copy.headline: One last love letter: San Antonio Zoo mourns Fiona, Timothy the hippo’s longtime sweetheart
copy.caption: Timothy’s final farewell to Fiona is scheduled for Friday afternoon as San Antonio Zoo remembers a playful romance filled with letters, gifts and birthday surprises.
